## About
R.B. Paint & Body Center is an auto body and collision shop at 10850 Norwalk Blvd in Santa Fe Springs. We handle paint, glass, dents, bumpers, fenders and frame unibody work.
When you bring your vehicle to us, you're not simply a number. We keep you informed along the way, and our workmanship is backed by a lifetime written warranty.
We're open Monday through Friday, and we hold a 4.1 rating from 81 Google reviews.

## Services
- Paint matching: Chipped, scratched or damaged paint restored with computerized paint matching and careful finishing touches.
- Collision glass: Laminated glass that was cracked, chipped or shattered in a collision, repaired or replaced.
- Auto dent repair: From major damage to small cosmetic dents.
- Bumper repair: Safe bumper repair after a collision, with the right tools for the job.
- Fender repair: Fender repair for any body material and any level of damage.
- Frame unibody repair: Bent or twisted frames brought back to factory specifications.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help with my insurance claim?
A: One reviewer said Tony handled their claim, worked with their insurance, and kept them updated through the process. Give us a call to talk about your claim.

Q: Can you help me get a rental car?
A: A reviewer said we helped with rental car service after their accident. Ask us about it when you call.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Saturday is by appointment only, so please call ahead.
